memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: But the whole assembly talked about stoning them. Then the glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting to all the Israelites. The Lord said to Moses, "How long will these people treat me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the signs I have performed among them?" — Num 14:10-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The people's answer to faith is violence: "the whole assembly talked about stoning them." This is how far unbelief had carried them — they were ready to kill the only two men telling the truth. Rebellion against God so often turns to hostility against those who speak for Him.

But at the very moment the stones might have flown, "the glory of the Lord appeared." God intervenes to protect His faithful servants. He is never absent when His people stand for Him, even when it feels like they stand alone. The same glory that had led them out of Egypt now shields Joshua and Caleb.

Then God speaks, and His words are aching with grief: "How long will these people treat me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the signs?" Notice how God frames their unbelief. It is not a small weakness; it is contempt. To refuse to trust God after all He has done is to insult His character and despise His faithfulness.

We can be tempted to think of doubt as harmless, even humble. But persistent unbelief, in the face of all God's proven goodness, wounds His heart. He had split the sea, fed them daily, dwelt among them — and still they would not trust Him. May we not treat God's faithfulness so lightly. Every remembered mercy is a reason to believe Him for the next step. Look back at all He has done, and let it fuel your trust going forward.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Does rebellion in your heart ever turn into hostility toward God's truth?
2. Do you take unbelief as seriously as God does here?
3. What "signs" of God's past faithfulness can fuel your trust today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, forgive me when my unbelief has treated Your faithfulness with contempt. Help me to remember all You have done and let it strengthen my trust. Thank You that Your glory protects those who stand for You. Amen.
